{{Quote|noquote=1|<nowiki></nowiki>''[Latara shrieks] "''What is it?''"<br />"''Someone turned this beast into crystal!|Latara and Wicket, upon first seeing the creature|<ref name="CC" />}}
A '''six-legged creature''' lived on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]], and at least one member of the [[Species/Legends|species]] lived on the [[Floating Mountain]] with the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] being known as [[Gracca]]. With the [[Magic/Legends|powers]] of an artifact known as the [[Crystal Cloak]], which he had stolen from the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]]' [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]], Gracca turned the creature into pure [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] at some point prior to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. The creature was eventually discovered by the Ewoks [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] and [[Latara/Legends|Latara]] when they went to the Floating Mountain to retrieve the cloak. Latara later carried the crystallized creature home with her on her [[Hang-glider/Legends|skin glider]].

==Biology and appearance==
Sporting six [[Limb/Legends|legs]] and a long tail, the creature had a multi-spiked frill protruding behind its two [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. Its large jaw was long and pointed, and contained several sharp [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]].<ref name="CC" />

==History==
{{Quote|Hey, Wicket! You didn't tell me ''I'd'' have to carry my crystal back!|Latara, carrying the creature on her skin glider|<ref name="CC" />}}
[[File:LataraFlying-TCC.png|thumb|left|200px|Latara brings the creature home on her glider.]]
The six-legged creature lived on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]],<ref name="CC" /> which featured a wide variety of terrains.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> At least one of these creatures made its home on the [[Floating Mountain]] with the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] being named [[Gracca]], who possessed a [[Magic/Legends|magical]] [[Crystal Cloak]] he had stolen from the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]]' [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] earlier and had used to rule the whole of the [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]].<ref name="CC" /><ref name="EGC 184">''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> During his rule, Gracca turned several creatures&mdash;including the six-legged creature&mdash;into [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] with the magic of his cloak, sometimes accidentally by forgetting his powers, and other [[Time/Legends|times]] willfully, because the creatures refused to serve him or displeased him in some other way.<ref name="CC" /> The six-legged creature's crystallized [[Death/Legends|corpse]] remained on the mountain with Gracca until [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="EwoksDate">{{EwoksDate|appearance of the six-[[Limb/Legends|legged]] [[Species/Legends|creature]]|[[The Crystal Cloak]]}}</ref> when it was discovered by the Ewoks [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] and [[Latara/Legends|Latara]], who had come to the mountain to reclaim the stolen cloak. After a [[Skirmish on the Floating Mountain|skirmish]] with Gracca, which saw the cloak destroyed and its de facto owner incapacitated, the creature was kept as a trophy by Latara, who brought it back to Bright Tree Village on her [[Hang-glider/Legends|skin glider]].<ref name="CC" />

==Behind the scenes==
This creature went unnamed in the [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']] episode "[[The Crystal Cloak]]," in which it appeared only in a crystalline form. "The Crystal Cloak" was the first episode of the [[Ewoks: Season Two|second season]] of the ''Ewoks'' television series and originally aired on [[September 13]], [[1986]].<ref name="Insider27">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref>
